newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev rises to 1,700-1,760 to dlr at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev rises to 1,700-1,760 to dlr at close.

text.p: The lev closed at 1,700-1,760 per dollar, up from midday's 1,760-1,820 and the morning's 2,000-2,050 as currency demand fell and supply rose on profit-taking, dealers said.
"The final clients that started bidding for relatively large dollar volumes at opening, withdrew from the market by midday while dollar sales for profit taking increased," one dealer said.
A rise in dollar demand from oil and gas importers pressured the lev to around 2,000-2,050 in early trade from Wednesday's close of 1,650-1,700.
The weaker lev encouraged dollar sales since midday from some final clients who had held up foreign currency at the lower dollar levels in the past several days, traders said.
The market might test the 2,000 level again tomorrow if the fuel importers resume bidding for dollars, dealers said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
